results.content: # Building Self-Improving Skills for Agents. **"Not just agents with skills, but agents with skills that can improve over time."**. The idea is simple: give an agent a folder of markdown files, each containing instructions for a specific task (i.e. summarization, bug triage, code review) and let the agent call on them as needed. But here's the uncomfortable truth we're all starting to face: **skills are usually static, while the environment around them is not.**. ## The Problem: Skills Are Static, While The Environment Around Them Is Not. A skill that worked perfectly a few weeks ago can quietly start failing when:. And it's why the "skills folder" approach, while promising, isn’t truly the silver bullet to resolve everything. But building a system where skills can actually **evolve when they fail or underperform.**. And the worst part of all is that no one knows if the issue is routing, instructions, or the tool call itself, which leads to manual maintenance and inspection.
